title: Extrapolation to tracts
text: CDC AtlasPlus reports many outcomes county level. analyses, especially geographic access analyses, may want estimates smaller geographic unit Census tract. CDCAtlas includes helper functions extrapolating county-level AtlasPlus counts Census tracts using tract-level Census denominators. basic idea : Retrieve county-level CDC AtlasPlus counts. Retrieve tract-level Census population denominators. Match tract parent county. Allocate county’s reported cases across tracts proportion tract’s share relevant county population. example, tract contains 2% county’s population relevant denominator, receives 2% county’s reported cases. population-weighted extrapolation, direct CDC tract-level surveillance estimate.

title: Extrapolation to tracts
text: Tract-level extrapolation requires tract-level population denominators U.S. Census Bureau. CDCAtlas uses tidycensus package retrieve denominators. use CDCAtlas retrieve AtlasPlus county, state, national data, need set tidycensus. However, use extrapolate_from_county(), need: tidycensus package installed Census API key API key saved R environment can install tidycensus CRAN: request free Census API key U.S. Census Bureau install using tidycensus::census_api_key(). See https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/ details.
code: install.packages("tidycensus")

title: Retrieve STI surveillance data from CDC AtlasPlus — get_atlas
text: disease single disease name (e.g. "gonorrhea"). Multiple diseases currently supported single request. geography Character scalar. One "national", "state", "county", "msa". Region-level queries supported yet. year Integer vector years. Valid values 2000 2023. Can single year (e.g., 2022) sequence (e.g., 2018:2022). stratify_by Optional character vector.
